Official individual records for 誰 (U+8AB0) and 隹 (U+96B9) were attempted but inaccessible in this pass; local rows are therefore not represented as externally verified character-specific records.

gaps: The Zhongshan inscription article could not be opened; its search-result transcription should not be treated as verified page content. A directly inspected inscription edition is still needed to substantiate the bare-隹 reading externally in this pass.

The exact local Baxter–Sagart rows establish the separate readings for 誰 and 隹 in MC and OC notation, but the search did not locate or inspect the original table online. The comparison does not prove a sound-component role or a whole-graph borrowing.

The official Unihan character pages for 誰 and 隹 could not be accessed. Their supplied local kMandarin rows are available, but an externally inspected character-specific Unicode record and click-through citation remain unverified.

The search surfaced simplified-form identification for 誰 → 谁 and the local dossier states 訁 → 讠, but no primary standardization source was successfully opened. The literal component pair 訁 → 讠 is not the same pair as 言 → 讠.

No independently inspected source establishes the pronunciation of the proposed horse-name 騅. Reconstructions of 誰 and 隹 cannot by themselves establish the horse name’s pronunciation or a sound-based borrowing from it.

The earliest dated attestation of 誰 as an interrogative pronoun, precise dates/provenance of cited bronze forms, semantic extensions’ chronology, and transitions between interrogative, assertive ‘anyone’, and rhetorical uses remain unresolved.
